stories.title: North Korea Says US-led Arms Buildup Justifies Expanding Nuclear Force

en.title: North Korea Says US-led Arms Buildup Justifies Expanding Nuclear Force
en.summary: North Korea stated that a US arms buildup justifies its efforts to strengthen its nuclear forces. The country indicated it would continue expanding its nuclear deterrent capabilities.

stories.title: North Korea vice defense minister says US arms buildup justifies expanding nuclear force

en.title: North Korea vice defense minister says US arms buildup justifies expanding nuclear force
en.summary: North Korea's Vice Defense Minister Kim Kang Il stated that US arms buildup justifies the country's efforts to strengthen its nuclear forces. Speaking at a security forum in China, he said Pyongyang would continue bolstering its self-defensive nuclear deterrent.

stories.title: Saudi crown prince sends condolences after death of British PM’s father

en.title: Saudi crown prince sends condolences after death of British PM's father
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman offered condolences to British Prime Minister Andy Burnham following the death of Burnham's father, who had advanced Alzheimer's disease.

stories.title: Saudi crown prince, French president discuss regional situation

en.title: Saudi crown prince, French president discuss regional situation
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman spoke by phone with French President Emmanuel Macron to review regional developments and discuss security, stability, and maritime navigation freedom.

stories.title: محمد بن سلمان وماكرون يبحثان جهود تعزيز أمن المنطقة

en.title: Mohammed bin Salman and Macron discuss efforts to enhance regional security
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman held a phone call with French President Emmanuel Macron to discuss efforts aimed at promoting security and stability in the region.

stories.title: فيصل بن سلمان ووزير المواصلات البحريني يبحثان تعزيز التكامل بين المكتبات الوطنية والمراكز البحثية في البلدين

en.title: Faisal bin Salman and Bahraini Transport Minister discuss enhancing integration between national libraries and research centers in both countries
en.summary: Prince Faisal bin Salman received Bahrain's Minister of Transportation and Communications to explore scientific and knowledge cooperation and strengthen ties between research centers and national libraries of both nations. A memorandum of understanding was signed between the two institutions.

stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince receives message from King Abdullah of Jordan

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince receives message from King Abdullah of Jordan
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman received a written message from Jordan's King Abdullah regarding bilateral relations between the two nations.

stories.title: Islamic world erupts in outrage over Houthi attack targeting Makkah

en.title: Islamic world erupts in outrage over Houthi attack targeting Makkah
en.summary: The Organization of Islamic Cooperation and Arab League, alongside multiple Arab and Islamic countries, condemned a Houthi attack on Makkah that endangered civilians and violated holy sites.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Terrorist Houthi Militia's Hostile Drone Targeting Makkah

en.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Terrorist Houthi Militia's Hostile Drone Targeting Makkah
en.summary: Saudi Arabia condemned the Houthi militia for a hostile drone operation targeting Makkah.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia asserts right to take all necessary measures after Houthi drone attack on Makkah

en.title: Saudi Arabia asserts right to take all necessary measures after Houthi drone attack on Makkah
en.summary: Saudi Arabia condemned a Houthi drone attack on Makkah and stated it reserves the right to take necessary defensive measures to protect the Two Holy Mosques and their pilgrims.

stories.title: MWL Condemns Houthi Militia Attacks on Makkah, Madinah

en.title: MWL Condemns Houthi Militia Attacks on Makkah, Madinah
en.summary: The Muslim World League condemned Houthi militia attacks targeting Makkah and Madinah.

stories.title: Yemen, Pakistan, Kuwait, OIC and MWL condemn Houthi attacks on Makkah

en.title: Yemen, Pakistan, Kuwait, OIC and MWL condemn Houthi attacks on Makkah
en.summary: Yemen, Pakistan, Kuwait, the Organization of Islamic Cooperation, and the Muslim World League condemned Houthi drone attacks on Makkah. The organizations expressed solidarity with Saudi Arabia and support for protecting Islamic holy sites.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Arabia eyes half East-West pipeline capacity within days: Report

en.title: Saudi Arabia eyes half East-West pipeline capacity within days: Report
en.summary: Saudi Arabia is working to restore approximately half of its cross-country pipeline capacity within days following drone attack damage last week. Saudi Aramco aims to achieve full capacity restoration within six weeks by bypassing the affected section.

stories.title: ‎SIC: Commitments near SAR 1B; 3 deals executed in 2026

en.title: SIC: Commitments near SAR 1B; 3 deals executed in 2026
en.summary: SIDF Investment Co. has investment commitments approaching SAR 1 billion, with recent commitments exceeding SAR 800 million. The company completed three investment deals since early 2026 and plans to update on total commitments by year-end.

stories.title: ‎Fed hikes rates for first time since 2023

en.title: Fed hikes rates for first time since 2023
en.summary: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4%, the first increase since July 2023. All FOMC members supported the decision, made amid solid economic expansion and resilient domestic spending.

stories.title: ‎SAMA raises reverse repo, repo rates by 25 bps

en.title: SAMA raises reverse repo, repo rates by 25 bps
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's central bank increased its reverse repo rate to 4% and repo rate to 4.50%, each by 25 basis points, following a matching rate hike by the US Federal Reserve.

en.title: Saudi home transactions fall in 2Q
en.summary: Saudi Arabia recorded 45,700 residential property transactions in the second quarter, down 12% year-over-year, as affordability concerns and regional uncertainty dampened buyer activity.
